newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Monday, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
February/March SIR20 was last sold at 54.63 fob Palembang, 54.13 fob Jambi and 54.50 fob Singapore on Friday.
"Sellers, particularly in Medan, are holding firm to their offer prices," one Jakarta dealer said, adding sellers had refused to lower their offer prices below the 55.00 level.
Another Jakarta dealer said there were some European bids at 124.5 cents/kg for February RSS1 fob Semarang, but no deals were done as they were still below his offer price of 126.00 cents.
